numeric_rule: strict-value-float: a ModifierArguments.Value counts as numeric iff str.strip(value) parses with Python float() (integers, signed numbers, decimals, exponents). Rejected as non-numeric/structural: empty strings, comma-separated lists (e.g. '2,2,1'), text IDs/selectors (yield/unit/ability type refs), localization keys, nested modifier references. No argument-name allow/deny list: every text-valued argument name in this snapshot is 100% non-numeric and the only mixed name is Amount (2010/2021 numeric; 11 comma-list/text values excluded). A (ModifierId, argument) pair is numeric if ANY row parses (audit: zero pairs mix numeric/non-numeric rows, so ANY == ALL; zero pairs have >1 distinct value).

nesting.edge: ModifierArguments row with Name='ModifierId' whose Value exists in Modifiers.ModifierId (304 edges from 304 parent modifiers; each parent has exactly 1 outgoing edge)
